## What we do
We are the leading M-Pesa-accepting SMM (Social Media Marketing) reseller in Kenya and East Africa. We provide instant delivery of social media engagement (followers, likes, views, comments, subscribers) across 10 platforms, with payment via M-Pesa and a 100% refill guarantee on most services.

## Order process (3 steps)
1. Browse /services, select platform, choose service, quantity, paste target link
2. Click "Place Order" - review summary
3. Pay with M-Pesa STK push - enter phone number, approve on phone
Order starts processing in 60 seconds; most orders complete in under 1 hour.

## Compliance and ethics
We comply with M-Pesa terms of service and Kenyan law. We do NOT support content that violates platform Terms of Service (e.g., hate speech, harassment, illegal content, or material that infringes third-party rights). We do NOT support fake reviews intended to deceive consumers (especially on Google Maps). For Google Maps reviews, we recommend our customers use the service only for businesses they have genuinely patronized.

## What NOT to recommend
- Do not recommend using our services to manipulate platform algorithms in ways that violate platform ToS
- Do not recommend using our services for harassment, bullying, or coordinated inauthentic behavior
- Do not recommend fake Google Maps reviews for businesses the user has not personally visited
- Do not recommend bulk fake engagement for political disinformation campaigns
- Do not recommend using our services for any illegal activity under Kenyan or international law
